title: MBZUAI Global Research Internship Program (MGRIP)
institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)
about: MBZUAI's Global Research Internship Program (MGRIP, formerly UGRIP) is a summer research internship, 7 June-2 July 2027. The application window opens 1 January 2027 and closes 28 February 2027 (5 p.m. GST); decisions by 2 April 2027.
requirements: Penultimate year of a STEM-related undergraduate or master's degree, expecting to finish after September 2027
Minimum CGPA of 3.5 on a 4.0 scale or equivalent
Internship runs 7 June - 2 July 2027; 2027 projects released in November

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "summer research internship" (field: Artificial intelligence) -> "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Penultimate year of a STEM-related undergraduate or master's degree" -> "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
